trigger: Independent M150 hammer review reconstructed frozen INT8 weight vectors and disproved the assumption that one source vector is identical across destination blocks.

required_repair.vector_supply: Use four independent destination-bank vector reads or a resident 6144-bit full source row; never reuse one 768-bit vector as four different frozen Conv weight vectors.
required_repair.key_switch: Charge load-to-use and source-key switch latency in the recurrence.
required_repair.numeric: Materialize destination and sign per event, then replay ordered signed INT8-to-Acc19 arithmetic.
required_repair.writeback: Implement four conflict-safe accumulator update paths and include SRAM port/macro cost.

paper_safe_statement: M150/M152 establish a reproducible cross-destination packing and modulo-four bank-conflict opportunity, but an independent frozen-weight audit disproves their single-vector multicast payload assumption. Their 1.805357581x cycle ratio is therefore not hardware-admitted pending four independent destination-vector supply and accumulator paths.
